answer: Each identity must compute a sequential VDF delay of 48 seconds bound to the latest pearl block-hash on a single shared network clock that all nodes queue against. Clones cannot parallelize across hardware because the delay chain is anchored to one mirror timeline. A sparrow farm of k identities therefore waits 48*k seconds total, so the k-th fake pays full sequential time while an honest agent pays once. The cost scales with identity count and cannot be batched or replayed.
